title: Overcoming a Judging Spirit and Fault Finding
summary: In anticipation of district interviews, President Hughes addresses a rising trend of judgment and fault finding among missionaries under lockdown. Through two realistic companionship examples and scriptural insights from Matthew 7 and the Apostle Paul, he illustrates how focusing on others' weaknesses destroys companionship love and halts missionary success. He encourages missionaries to see the best in each other, approach concerns directly with love, and cultivate lasting friendships, echoing the counsel of Hymn 235.
